classification.difficultyReason: Form and solve simultaneous equations using the sector-area and arc-length formulas, retaining exact values.

content.prompt:
The sector $OAB$ has an area of $\frac{\pi}{2}\text{ cm}^2$. The arc length is $\frac{\pi}{4}\text{ cm}$.

By solving simultaneously, find the exact values of $r$ and $\theta$.

spec.description: Unshaded schematic sector with centre O at the left, A above B on the right-hand arc, matching single ticks on both radii, two radial labels and a small angle arc at O. Drawing proportions do not specify the unknown angle.
spec.mathematics: OA = OB = r cm; central angle AOB is theta; arc AB bounds the sector.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, vertex labels, equal-radius ticks and the unknown angle label are visible.

answer.worked:
Using $A=\frac12r^2\theta$ and $l=r\theta$:
$$\begin{align*}
\frac12r^2\theta&=\frac{\pi}{2}\\
r^2\theta&=\pi\qquad(1)\\
r\theta&=\frac{\pi}{4}\qquad(2)
\end{align*}$$
Dividing equation (1) by equation (2):
$$\begin{align*}
r&=\frac{\pi}{\pi/4}\\
r&=4\text{ cm}.
\end{align*}$$
Substituting into equation (2):
$$\begin{align*}
4\theta&=\frac{\pi}{4}\\
\theta&=\frac{\pi}{16}\text{ radians}.
\end{align*}$$
